DECLARE

BEGIN

 EXIT_FORM(NO_VALIDATE);

END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 if vis = 'TRUE' then
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible, property_false);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 else
 TMPLT.Populate_Functions ;
 end if;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 IF vis = 'FALSE' THEN
 COPY(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM'), 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');
 END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 Set_Item_Property('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'STD_NORMAL_FUNCTION');

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 --STR.DISPALERT('SYSTEM.FORM_STATUS ' || :SYSTEM.FORM_STATUS ,'ERROR');
 --STR.DISPALERT('SYSTEM.RECORD_STATUS ' || :SYSTEM.RECORD_STATUS ,'ERROR');
IF :SYSTEM.RECORD_STATUS IN('NEW' ,'INSERT') AND :PC_REINI_RQSTS.DCLN_NBR IS NOT NULL
THEN
CALL_DCLTN_LOV;
BEGIN

SELECT NVL(AD.PORT_CNTRCTR_CD , VB.PORT_CNTRCTR_CD)
INTO :PC_REINI_RQSTS.PORT_CNTRCTR_CD
FROM DECLARATIONS DC ,
SEA_DLVY_ORDERS AD,
VSSL_BLS VB
WHERE DC.PORT_CD = AD.PORT_CD (+)
AND DC.DCLTN_ISN = AD.DCLTN_ISN (+)
AND DC.PORT_CD = VB.PORT_CD(+)
AND DC.DCLTN_ISN = VB.DCLTN_ISN(+)
AND DC.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
AND DC.DCLTN_ISN = :PC_REINI_RQSTS.DCLTN_ISN;
EXCEPTION
WHEN OTHERS
THEN NULL;
END;

IF :PC_REINI_RQSTS.PORT_CNTRCTR_CD IS NOT NULL
THEN

BEGIN
 SELECT PORT_CNTRCTR_ANAME
 INTO :PC_REINI_RQSTS.PORT_CNTRCTR_NAME
 FROM PORT_CONTRACTORS
 WHERE PORT_CNTRCTR_CD =:PC_REINI_RQSTS.PORT_CNTRCTR_CD;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN NULL;
END;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PC_REINI_RQSTS.PORT_CNTRCTR_CD',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PC_REINI_RQSTS.PORT_CNTRCTR_CD',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

END IF;

END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;

BEGIN
IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 40202 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب إدخال حقل '||' ' || GET_ITEM_PROPERTY (:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_ITEM , PROMPT_TEXT) ,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 40200 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('غير مسموح بتعديل'||' ' || GET_ITEM_PROPERTY (:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_ITEM , PROMPT_TEXT) ,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 41049 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكنك حذف هذا السجل','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 40401 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكنك حذف هذا السجل','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 40400 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('تم الحفظ بنجاح','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'PI_SLCS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الجهة المعنية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'PI_RT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع الطلب' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'PI_PR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز طالب الخدمة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'PI_PC_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز المشغل' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'PI_DCLTN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'الرقم المبدئي للبيان,رمز الجمرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VCI_PI_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'PC_REINI_RQSTS','VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'PRINI_PI_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'PC_REINI_RQSTS','PC_REINI_INSPCTORS' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

DECLARE
V_COUNT NUMBER ;
BEGIN
-- wakeel hash TO know how match WITH samples
IF :STAKEHOLDER_CD IN (5,15)

--AND SI.RQST_DT = SCI.RQST_DT

:PC_REINI_RQSTS.PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD;
:PC_REINI_RQSTS.CREATION_DATE := SYSDATE;

/* CGGN$KEY_DELREC */

 CG$CHK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;

 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-HELP
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGHP$CALL_HELP_FORM */
/* Call the help system after setting globals with current block and item */
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := '';
 IF (:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE IS NULL) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(23, 'Help file is missing or incorrect'), 'W', 'OFG', 23);
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HPATH || '';
 BEGIN
 CGHP$CALL_MS_HELP(
 0 /* IN : Help Context Id */
 ,:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE); /* IN : Help Resource File */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_NBR , DCLTN_DT , DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 INTO :PC_REINI_RQSTS.DCLN_NBR,:PC_REINI_RQSTS.DCLN_DATE , :PC_REINI_RQSTS.DCLN_TYPE
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE DCLTN_ISN = :PC_REINI_RQSTS.DCLTN_ISN;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN NULL;
END;

BEGIN
 SELECT REQUEST_TYPE_DESC
 INTO :PC_REINI_RQSTS.REQUEST_TYPE_NAME
 FROM PC_REQUEST_TYPES
 WHERE REQUEST_TYPE_CD =:PC_REINI_RQSTS.REQUEST_TYPE;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN NULL;
END;

BEGIN
 SELECT PC_REQUESTER_DESC
 INTO :PC_REINI_RQSTS.REQUESTER_NAME
 FROM PC_REQUESTRS
 WHERE PC_REQUESTER_CD =:PC_REINI_RQSTS.REQUESTER_CD;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN NULL;
END;

BEGIN
 SELECT LAB_NAME
 INTO :PC_REINI_RQSTS.STAKEHOLDER_NAME
 FROM SMPL_LABS
 WHERE LAB_CD =:PC_REINI_RQSTS.STAKEHOLDER_CD;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN NULL;
END;

BEGIN
 SELECT PORT_CNTRCTR_ANAME
 INTO :PC_REINI_RQSTS.PORT_CNTRCTR_NAME
 FROM PORT_CONTRACTORS
 WHERE PORT_CNTRCTR_CD =:PC_REINI_RQSTS.PORT_CNTRCTR_CD;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN NULL;
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-UPDATE
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN

:PC_REINI_RQSTS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE := SYSDATE;

END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 40202 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب إدخال حقل '||' ' || GET_ITEM_PROPERTY (:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_ITEM , PROMPT_TEXT) ,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 40200 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('غير مسموح بتعديل'||' ' || GET_ITEM_PROPERTY (:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_ITEM , PROMPT_TEXT) ,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 41049 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكنك حذف هذا السجل','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 40401 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكنك حذف هذا السجل','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 40400 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('تم الحفظ بنجاح','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VCI_VCNTS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'CNTNR_SEQ,MFST_NBR,MFST_DT,MFST_TYPE' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VCI_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('المستخدم غير معروف', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VCI_SD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'الرقم المبدئي للبيان الإحصائي,جمرك المستخدم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VCI_PI_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'جمرك المستخدم,سلسل داخلي للطلبات خدمات المشغل' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VCI_DCLTN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'DCLTN_ISN,USER_PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'Vssl','جدول الخدمات التي يتم طلبها من المشغل' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'Vss','جدول الخدمات التي يتم طلبها من المشغل' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

/* CGHP$CALL_HELP_FORM */
/* Call the help system after setting globals with current block and item */
BEGIN

 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(23, 'Help file is missing or incorrect'), 'W', 'OFG', 23);

 BEGIN
 CGHP$CALL_MS_HELP(
 0 /* IN : Help Context Id */
 ,:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE); /* IN : Help Resource File */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-INSERT
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
V_COUNT NUMBER;
V_DCLTN_STATS NUMBER ;
BEGIN
-- wakeel hash TO know how match WITH samples
IF :STAKEHOLDER_CD IN (5,15)
THEN
SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM SMPL_REQUESTS SR, SMPL_ITEMS SI --, SMPL_CNTNR_INSPECT SCI
 WHERE SR.RQST_PORT_CD = SI.RQST_PORT_CD
 AND SR.RQST_NMR = SI.RQST_NMR
 AND SR.RQST_DT = SI.RQST_DT
--AND SI.RQST_PORT_CD = SCI.PORT_CD
--AND SI.RQST_NMR = SCI.RQST_NMR
--AND SI.RQST_DT = SCI.RQST_DT
--AND SI.SMPL_NBR = SCI.SMPL_NBR
 AND SR.LAB_CD = :PC_REINI_RQSTS.STAKEHOLDER_CD
 AND SI.CNTNR_MRK = :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.CNTNR_MRK ;--OR SCI.CNTNR_MRK = :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.CNTNR_MRK ) ;


IF V_COUNT = 0
THEN
 :GLOBAL.FUNS := 0 ;
 STR.DISPALERT(' الحاوية غير مربوطة مع صنف طلب التحليل للجهة المعنية','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

END IF;

IF CHK_RQUESTS > 0 AND :REQUEST_TYPE IN (1,2) THEN -- HATEM WAKEEL ADD
 STR.DISPALERT('غير مسموح بتقريب او تفريع الحاوية الحالية --يوجد طلب حجز','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;


IF Release_reservation > 0 AND :REQUEST_TYPE = 13 THEN -- HATEM WAKEEL ADD
 STR.DISPALERT('الحاوية محجوزة من جهة اخري','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;


BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(MAX(INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ)+1,1)
 INTO :INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ = :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.CNTNR_SEQ;
END;

:VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD;
:VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.INSPCT_ACTN_DATE := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
:VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.INSPCT_ACTN_TIME:= SYSDATE;
:VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.INSPCT_STA_CD:= 1;
:VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.USER_PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD;
:VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.USER_ID :=:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;



IF :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.CHECK_TYPE = 1 -- فحص يدوي
THEN
:VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.INSPCT_ACTN_CD:= 5;
:VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.INSPCT_RESULT_CD := 8;

ELSIF :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.CHECK_TYPE = 2 -- تقريب
THEN
:VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.INSPCT_ACTN_CD:= 5;
:VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.INSPCT_RESULT_CD := 7;

ELSIF :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.CHECK_TYPE = 3 -- فحص وسائل
THEN
:VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.INSPCT_ACTN_CD:= 5;
:VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.INSPCT_RESULT_CD := 8;
:VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.ISD_FLAG := 1;
END IF;


IF :PC_REINI_RQSTS.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL
THEN :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.DCLTN_ISN := :PC_REINI_RQSTS.DCLTN_ISN;
END IF;



END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 40202 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب إدخال حقل '||' ' || GET_ITEM_PROPERTY (:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_ITEM , PROMPT_TEXT) ,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 40200 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('غير مسموح بتعديل'||' ' || GET_ITEM_PROPERTY (:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_ITEM , PROMPT_TEXT) ,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 41049 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكنك حذف هذا السجل','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 40401 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكنك حذف هذا السجل','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 40400 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('تم الحفظ بنجاح','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'PRINI_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز المستخدم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'PRINI_PI_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الجمرك,مسلسل طلبات المشغل' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'PRINI_DSDR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'يمثل جهة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'جدول','جدول الخدمات التي يتم طلبها من المشغل' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'جدو','جدول الخدمات التي يتم طلبها من المشغل' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_REPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE PRINT_REPORT(FN In VARCHAR2, PL_ID PARAMLIST, V_REP_FRM_FLG NUMBER, V_REP_PRNT_FLG NUMBER) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;


 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
/*
 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;
*/
 BEGIN
/* IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD LIKE FN THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE = 6
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);

 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);

 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_REP_FRM_FLG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF V_REP_PRNT_FLG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 rep.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 rep.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('مسار ملف التقرير غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('ملف التقرير غير معرف داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;*/

ProgramUnit.Name: EXECUTE_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE Execute_Function(FN In VARCHAR2) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;
 CD_TITLE VARCHAR2(200);
 RET NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);

 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 pl_id ParamList;
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;

 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 CD_TITLE := NAME_IN(FN);

 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).TITLE LIKE CD_TITLE AND TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).ACT = 1 THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE IN (5,6)
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list TMPLT_MOD_CALL IN TEMPLATE ', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);
 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_SYS_TYPE = 5 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSE
 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ ||'-'||V_SEQ_NO);
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).FORM_FLAG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PRNT_FLAG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');

 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;

 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||'TMPLT_MOD_CALL'||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('خطأ داخلي في أكواد الوظائف - إتصل بالمساندة الفنية' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END Execute_Function;

ProgramUnit.Name: CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE */
PROCEDURE CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE IS
BEGIN
/* CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS */
/* Read the values for dynamic lists from the CG_REF_CODES table */
BEGIN
 CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
END;

/* CGLY$INIT_CANVASES */
/* Call procedure to ensure correct canvases are visible */
BEGIN
 CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT;
END;


/* CGLT$INIT_TAB_BLOCKS */
/* Initialise tabbed canvases */
BEGIN
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := TRUE;
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.CGLT$NEW_BLOCK;
END;

/* CGBS$STARTUP */
/* Perform start-up processing for Block Synchronization */
BEGIN
 /* Set the defaults for the globals */
 :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 /* Set the relations to the default query mode */
 CGBS$.SET_RELATIONS( :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
 /* Set the query mode items */
 CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE( :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS */
PROCEDURE CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS IS
/* Read each lists values from its record group and populate the list */
 temp NUMBER; /* Return value of populate_group call */
 rg_id RECORDGROUP; /* Return value of populate_group call */
BEGIN
 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''STAGE_CD'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('PC_REINI_RQSTS.STAGE_CD', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''SND_RCV_STA'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('PC_REINI_RQSTS.SND_RCV_STA', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''MFST_TYPES'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.MFST_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

END;

 P_PC_REINI_REQUEST_ISN IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.PC_REINI_REQUEST_ISN. */
 ,P_USER_PORT_CD IN NUMBER) IS /* Value in Item :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.USER_PORT_CD. */

 CG$DUMMY VARCHAR2(1);

 WHERE PORT_CD = P_USER_PORT_CD
 AND PC_REINI_REQUEST_ISN = P_PC_REINI_REQUEST_ISN;

 FETCH C
 INTO CG$DUMMY;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN

 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGRI$CHK_PC_REINI_RQSTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGRI$CHK_PC_REINI_RQSTS */
PROCEDURE CGRI$CHK_PC_REINI_RQSTS(
 P_CHECK_BOTH IN BOOLEAN /* Check FKs validated in BOTH (client/server)? */
 ,P_PORT_CD IN NUMBER /* Item value */
 ,P_PC_REINI_REQUEST_ISN IN NUMBER ) IS /* Item value */
/* Validate that the deletion of the record is permitted */
/* by checking for the existence of rows in related tables. */
 CG$DUMMY VARCHAR2(1); /* Dummy variable */
BEGIN
 /* Deletion of PC_REINI_RQSTS prevented if VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS records exist */
 /* Foreign key(s): VCI_PI_FK */
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT '1'
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VCI
 WHERE VCI.USER_PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND (VCI.PC_REINI_REQUEST_ISN = P_PC_REINI_REQUEST_ISN OR
 (VCI.PC_REINI_REQUEST_ISN IS NULL AND
 P_PC_REINI_REQUEST_ISN IS NULL ));
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO CG$DUMMY;
 IF C%FOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'PC_REINI_RQSTS','VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;

 /* Deletion of PC_REINI_RQSTS prevented if PC_REINI_INSPCTORS records exist */
 /* Foreign key(s): PRINI_PI_FK */
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT '1'
 FROM PC_REINI_INSPCTORS PRINI
 WHERE PRINI.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND PRINI.PC_REINI_REQUEST_ISN = P_PC_REINI_REQUEST_ISN;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO CG$DUMMY;
 IF C%FOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'PC_REINI_RQSTS','PC_REINI_INSPCTORS' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'PC_REINI_INSPCT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الجمرك,مسلسل الطلب' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VCI_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'تسلسل الفحص,رمز الجمرك التسجيل,رقم المان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'PRINI_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'ترتيب الفحص,رمز الجمرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES */
PROCEDURE CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES(
 P_CANVAS_LIST IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* List of displayed canvases */
 ,P_CURRENT_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2 /* Current canvas */
 ,P_BASE_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Base canvas */
/* Display the current canvas plus any others in the canvas list */
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255); /* List of displayed canvases */
 canvas_to_raise VARCHAR2(255); /* Canvas to raise to the top */
BEGIN
 IF ( P_CURRENT_CANVAS = P_BASE_CANVAS) THEN
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 ELSE
 P_CANVAS_LIST := replace(P_CANVAS_LIST, P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',');
 IF ( get_view_property(P_BASE_CANVAS, VISIBLE) = 'FALSE') THEN
 canvas_list := P_CANVAS_LIST;
 WHILE (canvas_list IS NOT NULL) LOOP
 canvas_to_raise := substr(canvas_list, 1, instr(canvas_list, ','));
 canvas_list := replace(canvas_list, canvas_to_raise);
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(rtrim(canvas_to_raise, ','));
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CANVAS_LIST || P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 END IF;
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(P_CURRENT_CANVAS);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES */
PROCEDURE CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES(
 P_CURRENT_CANVAS IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Current canvas */
 ,P_BASE_CANVAS IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS /* Base canvas */
/* Find the canvases associated with the current canvas and record which */
/* base canvas is displayed in each window */
BEGIN
 IF ( P_current_canvas = 'CG$M_TAB_1') THEN
 P_base_canvas := 'CG$PAGE_1';
 ELSE
 P_BASE_CANVAS := P_CURRENT_CANVAS;
 END IF;
 IF (get_view_property(P_CURRENT_CANVAS, WINDOW_NAME) = 'CGSO$WINDOW_1') THEN
 :CG$CTRL.CG$WINDOWCGSO$WINDOW_1_PAGE := P_BASE_CANVAS;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS */
PROCEDURE CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(
 P_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Current canvas */
/* Raise the current canvas, plus any dependant canvases to the top */
BEGIN
 set_view_property(P_CANVAS, VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 IF ( P_canvas = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 set_view_property('CG$M_TAB_1', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT */
PROCEDURE CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT IS
/* Top level canvas management procedure */
 current_canvas VARCHAR2(61) := get_item_property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ITEM_CANVAS);
 base_canvas VARCHAR2(61);
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255);
BEGIN
 IF ( (:CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS IS NULL) OR (:CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS != current_canvas) ) THEN
 :CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS := current_canvas;
 set_window_property( get_view_property( current_canvas, WINDOW_NAME ), VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES(current_canvas, base_canvas);
 IF ( base_canvas = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 canvas_list := :CG$CTRL.CG$PAGE_1_LIST;
 END IF;
 CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES(canvas_list, current_canvas, base_canvas);
 IF ( base_canvas = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 :CG$CTRL.CG$PAGE_1_LIST := canvas_list;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGBS$TOGGLE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE */
PROCEDURE CGBS$TOGGLE(
 P_QUERY_MODE IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS /* Query Mode */
/* Toggle query mode between BSMON and BSMOFF, set all query mode items, */
/* display query mode message, set the relations and ensure that the */
/* canvas is coordinated. */
BEGIN
 /* Toggle the mode */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE != 'A') THEN
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 ELSE
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 END IF;
 /* Set all the items */
 CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Display query mode messages */
 CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Set the relations */
 CGBS$.SET_RELATIONS( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* If the query mode is AutoQuery, coordinate outstanding blocks */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE = 'A') THEN
 CGBS$.COORD_VISIBLE_BLKS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK );
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RELEASE_RESERVATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION Release_reservation RETURN NUMBER IS -- HATEM WAKEEL ADD
V_count NUMBER ;
BEGIN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_count
 FROM PC_SUPPORTIVE_INI PCI, PC_SUPPORTIVEINI_DTLS PCID
 WHERE PCI.PORT_CD = PCID.PORT_CD
 AND PCI.PC_SUPPORTIVE_INI_ISN = PCID.PC_SUPPORTIVE_INI_ISN
 AND PCI.REQUEST_TYPE = 10
 AND PCID.MFST_PORT_CD = :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.PORT_CD
 AND PCID.MFST_NBR =:VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.MFST_NBR
 AND PCID.MFST_DT = :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.MFST_DT
 AND PCID.MFST_TYPE = :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.MFST_TYPE
 AND PCI.REQUESTER_CD <> :PC_REINI_RQSTS.REQUESTER_CD
 AND NOT EXISTS
 (SELECT 1
 FROM PC_SUPPORTIVE_INI PCI1
 WHERE PCI1.REQUESTER_CD = PCI.REQUESTER_CD
 AND PCI1.REQUEST_TYPE = 13
 AND PCI1.PC_SUPPORTIVE_INI_ISN > PCI.PC_SUPPORTIVE_INI_ISN) ;

 RETURN V_count ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUN_PC_0001
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUN_PC_0001 IS
V_LINK_PC_DIRECT NUMBER := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('LINK_PC_DIRECT', 21), 0) ;
V_LINK_EDI_NEW NUMBER := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('LINK_EDI_NEW', 21), 0) ;
V_PORT_CONTRACT_LINK_TYPE NUMBER;
BEGIN

IF CHK_RQUESTS > 0 AND :REQUEST_TYPE IN (1,2) THEN -- HATEM WAKEEL ADD
 STR.DISPALERT('غير مسموح بتقريب او تفريع الحاوية الحالية --يوجد طلب حجز','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF Release_reservation > 0 AND :REQUEST_TYPE = 13 THEN -- HATEM WAKEEL ADD
 STR.DISPALERT('الحاوية محجوزة من جهة اخري','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* IF :SND_RCV_STA = 2 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('غير مسموح بإرسال الطلب حالة الإرسال مرسلة للشركة','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF ;
*/
 IF V_LINK_EDI_NEW = 1 OR V_LINK_PC_DIRECT =1 THEN
 V_PORT_CONTRACT_LINK_TYPE := NVL (HOURS24_SERVICES.GET_PORT_CONTRACT_LINK_TYPE (:PC_REINI_RQSTS.PORT_CNTRCTR_CD,'DatabaseDecInspectIni'),0);
 ELSE
 V_PORT_CONTRACT_LINK_TYPE := 1;
 END IF;

/*

 IF V_PORT_CONTRACT_LINK_TYPE IN (1,4,5,6) -- الربط القديم
 THEN
 EDI_TRG.DATABASE_XML_CREATE (2,
 'IDEC_MSG.DecIni',
 'DatabaseDecInspectIni',
 'DEC',
 'DECLARATIONS',
 :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.DCLTN_ISN,
 :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 STANDARD.COMMIT;
 END IF;
 */

 IF V_PORT_CONTRACT_LINK_TYPE IN (2,4,5,7) --ربط تبادل الجديد
 THEN
 EDI_TRG.DATABASE_XML_CREATE (2,
 'IDEC_MSG.SeaIni',
 'DatabaseDecPcInspect',
 'DEC',
 'PC_REINI_RQSTS',
 :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,
 :PC_REINI_RQSTS.PC_REINI_REQUEST_ISN);

 END IF;


 IF V_PORT_CONTRACT_LINK_TYPE IN (3,4,6,7) -- الربط المباشر
 THEN
 EDI_TRG.DATABASE_XML_CREATE (2,
 :PC_REINI_RQSTS.PORT_CNTRCTR_CD,
 'DatabaseDecInspectIni',
 'PCD',
 'PC_REINI_RQSTS',
 :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,
 :PC_REINI_RQSTS.PC_REINI_REQUEST_ISN);
 END IF;


:PC_REINI_RQSTS.SND_RCV_STA := 2;
 STANDARD.COMMIT;
 STR.DISPALERT('تم الارسال بنجاح','INFORMATION');


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_RQUESTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_RQUESTS RETURN NUMBER -- HATEM WAKEEL ADD CHECK
IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER ;

BEGIN

 SELECT COUNT (*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM PC_SUPPORTIVE_INI PCI, PC_SUPPORTIVEINI_DTLS PCID
 WHERE PCI.PORT_CD = PCID.PORT_CD
 AND PCI.PC_SUPPORTIVE_INI_ISN = PCID.PC_SUPPORTIVE_INI_ISN
 AND PCI.REQUEST_TYPE = 10
 AND PCID.MFST_PORT_CD = :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.PORT_CD
 AND PCID.MFST_NBR = :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.MFST_NBR
 AND PCID.MFST_DT = :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.MFST_DT
 AND PCID.MFST_TYPE = :VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS.MFST_TYPE
 AND PCI.REQUESTER_CD <> :PC_REINI_RQSTS.REQUESTER_CD
 AND NOT EXISTS
 (SELECT 1
 FROM PC_SUPPORTIVE_INI PCI1
 WHERE PCI1.REQUESTER_CD = PCI.REQUESTER_CD
 AND PCI1.REQUEST_TYPE = 13
 AND PCI1.PC_SUPPORTIVE_INI_ISN > PCI.PC_SUPPORTIVE_INI_ISN) ;

 RETURN V_COUNT ;

END;

 P_COL_2 VARCHAR2(1000);

Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
/*DECLARE
 cust_clk Timer;
 SYSTEM_DATE VARCHAR2(20);
 SDATE1 DATE;
 V_FUN_ITEM_REC LIB_APX_USR.TMPLT.CUR_Fun_Items%ROWTYPE;
 x number := 0.0;
-- y number := 5.25;
 y number := 5.17;
 RET PLS_INTEGER;
 WND PLS_INTEGER;
 ENAB VARCHAR2(100);

begin
 SET_WINDOW_PROPERTY(FORMS_MDI_WINDOW,WINDOW_STATE,MAXIMIZE);
 SET_WINDOW_PROPERTY('CGSO$WINDOW_1',WINDOW_STATE,MAXIMIZE);

 WND := WIN_API_UTILITY.GET_ACTIVE_WINDOW();
 RET := SEC_DLL.IsWndCaptionDisplayed(WND);
 IF RET = 1 THEN
 TOGGEL_WND;
 END IF;

 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_Y_POS := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VIEWPORT_Y_POS );
 TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_VIEW_Y_POS := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VIEWPORT_Y_POS_ON_CANVAS );
 TMPLT.HEIGHT := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', HEIGHT);


 TMPLT.LOAD_FUNCTIONS(:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID);
 TMPLT.ENB_DIS_FUN_BUT;


 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('TOOLBAR', visible, property_true);
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('TOOLBAR', display_position, x,y);
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY ('TITLE', visible, property_true);

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXIT1',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('RE_ENTER_QUERY',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('LAST_REC',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('FIRST_REC',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PAGE_UP',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PAGE_DOWN',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXECUTE',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 :GLOBAL.EXIT := 0;

 IF CHECK_TIMEOUT = TRUE THEN
 DECLARE
 hWind PLS_INTEGER;
 CheckTimer TIMER;
 BEGIN
 hWind := get_window_property(FORMS_MDI_WINDOW,WINDOW_HANDLE);
 Win_API_Session.Timeout_Start_Timer(hWind);
 CheckTimer := Create_Timer('CheckTimeout',120000,repeat);
 END;
 END IF;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF CHECK_EDI_ROLE_ID(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID) = TRUE THEN
IF CHECK_EDI_MSG_TIMER = TRUE THEN
 DECLARE
 TIMER_ID TIMER;
 V_VAR_VALUE VARCHAR2(200);
 V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN VARCHAR2(200);
 BEGIN
 V_VAR_VALUE := GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'EDI_MSG_TIMER',30);
 V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN := GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'MSG_DISPLAY_PERIOD',30);

 IF (V_VAR_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN IS NOT NULL) AND
 (V_VAR_VALUE > 0 AND V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN > 0) THEN

 TIMER_ID := Find_Timer('EDI_MSG');
 IF Id_Null(TIMER_ID) THEN
 TIMER_ID := CREATE_TIMER('EDI_MSG',V_VAR_VALUE, REPEAT);
 ELSE
 Set_Timer(TIMER_ID,1, REPEAT);
 END IF;

 TIMER_ID := Find_Timer('RETURN_EDI_MSG');
 IF Id_Null(TIMER_ID) THEN
 TIMER_ID := CREATE_TIMER('RETURN_EDI_MSG',V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN, REPEAT);
 ELSE
 Set_Timer(TIMER_ID,1, REPEAT);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;
END IF;
END IF;
 :GLOBAL.G_TIME_OUT := 0;
 :GLOBAL.TIMER := 0;
 :global.item_name := NULL;


BEGIN
SYS.DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.set_module (NVL(:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME,'NEBRAS')||' '||nvl(:GLOBAL.current_ver,' '), NULL);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
END;
END;

 errtxt VARCHAR2(2000) := ERROR_TEXT;

 BEGIN
 IF errtyp = 'FRM' THEN

 ELSIF errtyp = 'ORA' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ق';
 END IF;

 IF DBMS_ERROR_CODE = ERR_DB.GET_DB_ERR_CD THEN
 MsgTxt := ERR_DB.GET_LAST_ERROR;
 ELSE
 MsgTxt := errtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(errnum)||': '||errtxt;
 END IF;
 alert_is := find_alert('CFG_ERROR');

 if (not id_null(alert_is)) then
 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt );
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is);
 else
 Message(MsgTxt);
 end if;
 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER('ON_ERROR_TIMER');
 IF NOT ID_NULL(TIMER_ID) THEN
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 END IF;

 TIMER_ID := CREATE_TIMER('ON_ERROR_TIMER', 1, REPEAT);
 END;
 */

 NIB.ON_ERROR;

BEGIN
IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 40202 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب إدخال حقل '||' ' || GET_ITEM_PROPERTY (:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_ITEM , PROMPT_TEXT) ,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 40200 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('غير مسموح بتعديل'||' ' || GET_ITEM_PROPERTY (:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_ITEM , PROMPT_TEXT) ,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 41049 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكنك حذف هذا السجل','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 40401 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكنك حذف هذا السجل','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF ERROR_TYPE ='FRM' AND ERROR_CODE = 40400 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('تم الحفظ بنجاح','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-F9
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 PROP VARCHAR2(10);
 VIS VARCHAR2(200);
 V_FUN VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN
 VIS := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE);
 V_FUN := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('FUN_BUT',VISIBLE);

 IF VIS = 'TRUE' THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ELSE
 IF V_FUN = 'TRUE' THEN
 COPY(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM'), 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');

 TMPLT.Populate_Functions;
 TMPLT.USING_KEYB := TRUE;
 TMPLT.CURSOR_AT := 1;
 TMPLT.KEYB_UP_DOWN(0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-HELP
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGHP$CALL_HELP_FORM */
/* Call the help system after setting globals with current block and item */
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := '';
 IF (:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE IS NULL) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(23, 'Help file is missing or incorrect'), 'W', 'OFG', 23);
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HPATH || '';
 BEGIN
 CGHP$CALL_MS_HELP(
 0 /* IN : Help Context Id */
 ,:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE); /* IN : Help Resource File */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGLT$TAB_BLOCK_MANAGEMENT */
/* Switch tab management code on/off */
DECLARE
 current_canvas VARCHAR2(61) := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ITEM_CANVAS);
 base_canvas VARCHAR2(61);
BEGIN
 CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES(current_canvas, base_canvas);
 IF( base_canvas IN ( 'CG$PAGE_1' ) ) THEN
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := TRUE;
 ELSE
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := FALSE;
 END IF;
END;
/* CGLY$MANAGE_CANVASES */
/* Call procedure to ensure correct canvases are visible */
BEGIN
 CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT;
END;


/* CGLT$TAB_NEW_BLOCK */
/* Show canvases for this block */
BEGIN
 IF CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE = TRUE THEN
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.CGLT$NEW_BLOCK;
 END IF;
END;

/* CGBS$WHEN_NEW_BLOCK_INSTANCE */
/* ensure the current canvas is correctly coordinated */
BEGIN
 CGBS$.NEW_BLOCK( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE);
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-CLEAR-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$ON_CLEAR_DETAILS */
/* clear all detail blocks for the given master block */
BEGIN
 IF (FORM_FAILURE AND :SYSTEM.COORDINATION_OPERATION IN ('MOUSE', 'DUPLICATE_RECORD')) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF (:SYSTEM.MASTER_BLOCK = :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK) THEN
 CGBS$.CLEAR_MASTER_DETAIL( :SYSTEM.MASTER_BLOCK, :SYSTEM.COORDINATION_OPERATION );
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$ON_POPULATE_DETAILS */
/* query all detail blocks for the given master block */
BEGIN
 CGBS$.QUERY_DETAILS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CQUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$KEY_CQUERY_FRM */
/* Check if query is allowed to avoid unnecessary coordination */
BEGIN
 IF (get_block_property( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK, QUERY_ALLOWED) = 'FALSE') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(37, 'Query not allowed in this block'), 'E', 'OFG', 37);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 CGBS$.DO_KEYQRY( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK, 'COUNT_QUERY', :SYSTEM.MODE);
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$KEY_CLRREC */
/* Avoid clearing details if current row is new and invalid */
BEGIN
 IF ( CGBS2$.IS_RECORD_DIRTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK) ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF (:SYSTEM.BLOCK_STATUS = 'CHANGED' OR CGBS2$.IS_COMMIT_NEEDED( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK ) ) THEN
 CGBS2$.DO_COMMIT_DIALOGUE;
 END IF;
 clear_record;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NXTKEY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$DISABLE_NXTKEY */
/* Disable KEY-NXTKEY for the whole form */
BEGIN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(30, 'Key not valid in this context'), 'E', 'OFG', 30);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-MENU
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE_QUERY_MODE */
/* This changes the mode of block synchronization so that if it is */
/* currently ON, then it is changed to OFF, and vice-versa. */
/* It also queries the dependent blocks as appropriate for the */
/* new mode. */
BEGIN
 CGBS$TOGGLE( :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRFRM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGGN$KEY_CLRFRM */
/* Perform the key's standard functionality */
BEGIN
 clear_form;
 IF :SYSTEM.FORM_STATUS = 'CHANGED' THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

/* CGCF$PERFORM_STARTUP */
/* execute the when-new-form-instance code that was created by forms generator */
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-TAB-PAGE-CHANGED
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGLT$NEW_TAB_PAGE */
/* Show related canvases for this tab */
BEGIN
 IF( :SYSTEM.TAB_NEW_PAGE IN ( 'CG$M_TAB_1_PAGE_1', 'CG$M_TAB_1_PAGE_2' ) ) THEN
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := TRUE;
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.CGLT$TAB_CHANGED;
 END IF;
END;
